meta.title: Cladle - Phylogenetic Guessing Game
meta.description: A web-based phylogenetic guessing game where players guess animals and see evolutionary relationships visualized in a phylogenetic tree.

freePlay.subtitle: Free Play Mode
freePlay.tagline: Reset anytime to get a new random animal

game.suggestionAriaLabelSingle: {count} suggestion available. Use arrow keys to navigate, Enter to select.
game.suggestionAriaLabelPlural: {count} suggestions available. Use arrow keys to navigate, Enter to select.
game.firstGuessHint: Start by searching for an animal to see how it relates to the target
game.treeEmptyHint: Make your first guess to see the phylogenetic tree
game.treeInteractionHintDesktop: Click on nodes to explore details
game.treeEmptyState: No tree data available. Make a guess to see the phylogenetic tree.
game.searchOutage: iNaturalist is currently unavailable, so taxonomy and media search is temporarily degraded.

footer.tagline: A game to learn biodiversity through phylogeny and taxonomy.

informationPanel.stickyTabAriaLabel: Drag to remove post-it or click to close

history.title: Puzzle history
history.empty: No past puzzles yet. Complete puzzles to see them here.

errors.gameStart: Failed to start game. Please try again.
errors.gameReset: Failed to reset game. Please try again.
errors.animalNotFound: Animal not found. Please try a different name.
errors.networkError: Connection issue. Please check your internet and try again.
errors.validationError: Data format issue. This has been logged for investigation.
errors.apiUnavailable: Service temporarily unavailable. Cached data will be used when available.
errors.cacheError: Local storage issue. Game may have limited functionality.
errors.shareClipboardFailed: Couldn't copy results. Please check your browser permissions and try again.
errors.storageQuotaExceeded: Device storage is full. You can keep playing, but progress may not be saved. Please free up space if you want progress saved.
errors.storageWriteFailed: Could not save progress on this device. You can keep playing in this session. Please check storage or permissions if this continues.
errors.storageReadFailed: Could not load saved progress. Please continue - a fresh start will be used for this session.
errors.timeout: Request timed out. Please try again.
errors.notFound: Resource not found. Please check your input.
errors.parseError: Failed to parse response from server.
errors.offline: You appear to be offline. Please check your connection.

common.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.

share.title: Cladle
share.outcomeUnsolvedLine: Outcome: Did not solve in {guessCount} guesses.

winState.winWithoutName: Congratulations! You found the target animal!
winState.lossWithoutName: Game Over! Better luck next time.
winState.resultStatsLoss: You used all {maxGuesses} guesses. Keep learning and try again!
winState.furthestEvolutionaryDistanceHelp: Distance from the target to the most distant animal shown in the tree. Higher means at least one far relationship appears in this tree.
winState.evolutionaryDistanceHelp: How close your best guess was on the taxonomy ladder: lower is closer to the target. When you did not find the target, this counts how many taxonomic ranks still separated your closest guess from the target's deepest level.
winState.learningFootnote: Every guess traces a real branch of life, take a moment to see how species connect.
